acceleration.definition: The rate of change of velocity with time.
acceleration.example: A car that speeds up from 0 to 100 km/h in 10 s has an acceleration of 2.78 m/s².

fork.definition: A tool with a handle and sharp points. We use it for food in small pieces.
fork.example: I eat the fish with a fork.

toothbrush.definition: A small brush with bristles. You use it with toothpaste to clean your teeth.
